title: Data, models and code for: Oxygen-vacancy formation energies in non-magnetic oxides: how much do explicit electronic descriptors add to graph networks as training data grows?

creators.name: Lee, Aiden
creators.affiliation: Westview High School, San Diego, CA, USA

description:
Processed inputs, splits, job specifications, trained checkpoints, per-site predictions, result records and code for a study of graph-network prediction of neutral oxygen-vacancy formation energies in non-magnetic oxides, as a function of the number of training hosts. All DFT values come from the oxygen-vacancy database of Kumagai et al. (Phys. Rev. Materials 5, 123803, 2021; doi:10.1103/PhysRevMaterials.5.123803; CC BY 4.0). No new DFT calculations were performed.

Licences: derived data (processed tables, graphs, splits, predictions, result records) CC BY 4.0 with attribution to Kumagai et al.; code, job specifications and checkpoints MIT; MACE-MP-0 medium weights redistributed unchanged under the MIT License of ACEsuit/mace-foundations (text in MACE-MP-0_LICENSE.txt). Code: https://github.com/pa1aash/dft-gnn, cluster reference tag nrp-code-v1, final tag [FINAL-TAG-TBD]. README.md describes every file; FILES.sha256 lists the sha256 and size of every file and bundle member.

Checkpoints, relaxed structures and embeddings from the National Research Platform stages stay on NRP storage; their sha256 lists are in results/nrp/artefacts/ of the code snapshot, and copies can be requested from the corresponding author.
